skill.name: docx-official
skill.description: Create, edit, validate, and analyze DOCX files using OOXML, docx-js, and local document conversion workflows.
skill.summary: Guides DOCX creation, OOXML editing, redlining, validation, and conversion workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from OOXML namespaces, schema references, Markdown code examples, and guarded local document processing. The only confirmed issue is dependency guidance that recommends sudo apt-get installs, which can modify the host with elevated privileges. Static review was capped at 400/452 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 52 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Dependency instructions recommend sudo package installation.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before any sudo command and provide non-root or preflight alternatives when possible.

remediation.issue: Optional global tooling changes the user environment.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer project-local installs, documented prerequisites, or clear confirmation steps for npm, pandoc, LibreOffice, and Poppler setup.

remediation.issue: DOCX workflows process complex local archives and XML.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the existing safe extraction, path validation, defused XML parsing, and validation checks enabled by default.

content.value_statement: DOCX work often requires ZIP, XML, and Word-specific formatting knowledge. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through creation, editing, redlining, validation, and conversion workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use text extraction, raw OOXML access, docx-js, or redlining workflows.
Provides Python utilities for unpacking, packing, validating, and editing Office Open XML files.
Supports comments, comment replies, tracked change suggestions, relationship updates, and Word metadata files.
Documents docx-js patterns for paragraphs, tables, images, hyperlinks, headers, footers, and page layout.
Includes validation workflows for XML structure, relationships, schemas, whitespace, and redlining integrity.
Shows conversion steps for DOCX to PDF and page images using LibreOffice and Poppler.
limitations: Full workflow requires local tools such as pandoc, Node docx, LibreOffice, Poppler, and defusedxml.
The skill works on local documents and may create temporary directories or output files.
Direct OOXML edits can corrupt documents if validation is skipped or relationships are wrong.
It does not replace legal, accessibility, or compliance review for regulated documents.

use_cases.title: Create Structured Word Files
use_cases.description: Generate DOCX files with headings, tables, images, headers, footers, and consistent formatting from a written brief.

use_cases.title: Review Contracts With Tracked Changes
use_cases.description: Plan edits, apply redlines in OOXML, add comments, and validate that every change remains reviewable in Word.

use_cases.title: Inspect Complex DOCX Packages
use_cases.description: Unpack DOCX files, inspect relationships and XML parts, repair references, and repack validated documents.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple DOCX
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DOCX file for this outline. Use clear headings, normal body text, and a simple table where useful.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Word File
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this DOCX file. Extract the main text, summarize its structure, and identify comments, tracked changes, and embedded media.

prompt_templates.title: Edit With Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Update this DOCX file with the requested changes. Use the OOXML workflow, preserve formatting, and validate before saving.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Redlined Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare tracked changes for this legal document. Batch related edits, add reviewer comments, preserve unchanged text, and verify the final DOCX.

output_examples.input: Create a proposal document from a short outline and company image.
output_examples.output: A formatted DOCX with title page, section headings, body paragraphs, image placement, table content, and Word-compatible layout.

output_examples.input: Revise a contract clause while preserving tracked changes.
output_examples.output: A reviewed DOCX where removed text and inserted text appear as tracked changes, with comments explaining the revision.

output_examples.input: Check why a DOCX appears corrupt after manual editing.
output_examples.output: A validation report describing broken relationships, XML structure issues, missing content types, and recommended repair steps.

best_practices: Validate every edited document before sharing it with another user.
Use tracked changes for legal, business, academic, and government documents.
Keep original files unchanged until the edited DOCX has been validated and reviewed.
anti_patterns: Do not edit zipped DOCX contents without repacking and validating the package.
Do not replace whole paragraphs when only a small tracked change is needed.
Do not install or run optional system tools without explicit user approval.

faq.question: Can this skill create new Word documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses documented docx-js patterns to create DOCX files with common Word structures and formatting.

faq.question: Can it edit existing DOCX files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can unpack the package, edit OOXML parts, update relationships, validate files, and repack the document.

faq.question: Does it support tracked changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a redlining workflow for inserting reviewable deletions, insertions, and comments.

faq.question: What local tools may be needed?
faq.answer: Some workflows may need pandoc, Node docx, LibreOffice, Poppler, Python, and XML parsing libraries.

faq.question: Is it safe to use on important documents?
faq.answer: Use validation and keep backups. Direct OOXML editing is powerful but can create invalid documents when used incorrectly.

faq.question: Can it convert DOCX pages to images?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents a DOCX to PDF to image workflow using LibreOffice and Poppler tools.
